summary.summary: On 2026-01-19 around 05:30 UTC the auth-service generated two high‑severity alerts. Twenty distinct usernames from source ip_97c7dd873f32 failed login attempts within 10 minutes, hitting the credential‑stuffing threshold, and the same source produced 30 failed logins across 30 accounts in 5 minutes, triggering a brute‑force rule. Both alerts indicate a rapid, concentrated series of failed authentications far above normal traffic patterns.
summary.likely_trigger: The evidence points to a credential‑stuffing/brute‑force attack originating from ip_97c7dd873f32, matching MITRE ATT&CK T1110.004 and T1110 patterns.
summary.suggested_next_check: Inspect auth-service logs for ip_97c7dd873f32, verify rate‑limit and account lockout settings, and check for any compromised credentials.
